protocol.allocation: Seeded permuted blocks of two; full versus faded practice guidance

analysis_contract.allocation: Seeded permuted blocks of two compare full versus faded guidance only, not adaptive versus baseline policy.
analysis_contract.estimand: Descriptive within-participant competency evidence change after full versus faded guidance; not a causal learning-effect estimate.
exclusions: Phase incomplete or not server verified: outcome missing, never scored as zero.
Observed execution ticks below the frozen exposure minimum: retain evidence but exclude that phase from registered exposure-qualified summaries.
Undefined assessed denominator: report unassessable and missing rate; do not impute a correct rate.
A terminal disposition blocks new preparation and new session creation. Already-created sessions may finish; their evidence is retained and labeled with the disposition.
analysis_contract.missing_data: No imputation, last-observation carry-forward, silent replacement or exclusion based on poor score. Available eligible paired phases only; publish missingness and dispositions by arm.
analysis_contract.population: All consented allocated participants remain in the disposition report, including missing phases and terminal dispositions.
analysis_contract.power: Intended sample is an enrollment ceiling, not a power calculation. Empirical form equivalence and participant evaluation remain external requirements.

primary.denominator: One competency/contact/session vote from server-reconstructed evidence; unassessable observations reported separately.
primary.measure: correct / (correct + incorrect) for the registered competency, immediate minus baseline; undefined when either denominator is zero

analysis_contract.reporting: Participant counts, phase coverage, exposure exclusions and descriptive arm summaries only. No p-value, causal efficacy, calibrated mastery or operational certification is implied.

secondary.measure: The same descriptive change; report available pair counts and missing pair counts separately.
The same descriptive change; report available pair counts and missing pair counts separately.

analysis_contract.terminal_dispositions: withdrawn and dropout are append-only officer records. Neither permits reactivation; no training evidence is erased or reinterpreted.

limitations: Pilot infrastructure only; no participants or human efficacy are implied.
Structural form balance does not establish empirical equivalence.
Allocation is not blinded; local trainee identifiers are not strong research identity.
Facilitator must obtain appropriate consent/review before enrolling people. No operational certification.
protocol.primary_outcome: Descriptive immediate-minus-baseline correct proportion for the registered competency, with assessable denominators, incorrect/unassessable counts and original score reported separately
protocol.seed_schedule: Practice uses (registered seed + practice ordinal) modulo 2^32; assessment uses registered seed.
protocol.transfer_question: SYNTHETIC BROWSER QA ONLY — verify lifecycle gating, not a participant study.

dispositions.reason: SYNTHETIC QA ONLY — validate terminal launch gate; no human participant.

note: Missing outcomes remain missing. No human learning gain, causal effect or readiness is inferred.
